title: DndRoll
description: Neon D&D dice rolls with modifiers & crits.
body:
# 🎲 DndRoll — Stylish Dice Rolling Plugin for D&D Style!
DndRoll is a beautiful and intuitive dice rolling plugin for Paper 1.21.1+ servers. Perfect for D&D-style roleplay servers, it allows players to roll dice with modifiers and displays results in stunning neon blue-purple gradients — inspired by the FlectonePulse aesthetic!

#  ✨ Features
Multiple Dice Types — supports any dice format: XdY (e.g., 1d20, 2d6, 3d12, 1d100).

Modifiers — add or subtract modifiers: /dndroll 2d20+5, /dndroll 1d8-2.

Beautiful Neon Design — gradient headers, colored results, and critical hit/fail detection.

Smart Color Coding — results are color-coded based on roll quality (crits, high rolls, low rolls, fails).

Critical Detection — automatically detects and announces NATURAL 20 (critical success) and NATURAL 1 (critical failure) for d20 rolls.

Tab Completion — handy suggestions for common dice formats.

Broadcast to Server — roll results are displayed to all online players (immersion-friendly).

# 🎮 How It Works
Player enters command: /dndroll <dice>.

The plugin parses the dice notation, rolls each die, and applies any modifier.

Results are broadcast to the entire server with a stylish neon gradient design.

Special colors highlight:

Critical hits (max value) — bright purple/white

Critical fails (1) — dark purple

High rolls (>80%) — light purple

Low rolls (<20%) — medium purple

Normal rolls — light blue


<details>
<summary>🛠 Commands</summary>

/dndroll <количество>d<грани>[+/-модификатор] - Roll dice in D&D style	

Aliases: /roll, /droll, /кубик, /бросок

📋 Example Output
```
◈─────────────────────────────────◈
🎲 Rimuru кидает 2d20+3:
  Кубики: [15] + [18]
  Сумма кубиков: 33
  Модификатор: +3
  ════════════════
  ✦ ИТОГО: 36
◈─────────────────────────────────◈
```


</details>


# 📦 Installation
Download DndRoll-1.1.0.jar.

Place it in your server's plugins folder.

Restart your server (or run reload).

Done! Players can start rolling with /dndroll.



# ❓ FAQ
### Can players see each other's rolls?
Yes, all rolls are broadcast to the entire server for maximum immersion.

### Does it support critical detection for other dice types?
Critical detection is automatic for d20 rolls (natural 20/1). Other dice types still show color coding for max/min values.

### Can I customize the colors?
Currently, colors are fixed to the neon blue-purple theme. Future versions may include configurable colors.
